description: Get a link where the user uploads a scanned PDF or DjVu from their device. Use it when you cannot pass the user's file to fix_scan: no attachment, a file too large to attach, or a file attached in a chat that cannot hand attachments to tools. Show the user the link; when they say it is uploaded, call fix_scan (or preview_scan) with the upload_id. The link works for one hour and one file.
name: create_upload_link
title: Get an upload link
